scenes.text: This is forty trillion dollars. America's debt. In hundred-dollar bills.
Stack them up. Past the clouds. Past the space station...
...past the satellites! Forty-three thousand kilometers tall!
The space station? Only four hundred kilometers up.
So this stack is a hundred and seven times taller.
And it grows every single day. Follow, and I'll show you how fast.

title: $40 Trillion in $100 Bills Reaches Past the Satellites
